mapper.select: SELECT a.sku_id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName, s.spec_name AS specName, a.alias, a.version FROM xsy_customer_sku_alias a JOIN xsy_product_sku s ON s.id = a.sku_id JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY p.name, s.sku_code, a.id
